name: Money Market Overnight Index Swaps Statistical Report V 02
definition: The MoneyMarketOvernightIndexSwapsStatisticalReport message is sent by the reporting agents to the relevant competent authority, to report the daily overnight index swaps (OIS) transactions.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Provides the elements specific to the report.

OvernightIndexSwapsReport.name: Overnight Index Swaps Report
OvernightIndexSwapsReport.definition: Provides the reason why no activity is reported or the required list of transactions for the overnight index swaps segment.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
